whmatrixextms-benchmarking.ipynb: H_matrix_recursive, H_matrix, V_matrix; whmatrixextms.py fit_lasso (fit_intercept=False).

scope: Pinned author matrix functions agree entrywise with independent finite differences and public fitted coefficients on full and incomplete mixed-state designs.
preprocessing: Uniform observed Cartesian product; fitness as supplied, maximize=True, epsilon=0; no imputation, transformations, duplicates, sample weighting or measurement-error propagation; graph nodes verified unchanged. Reference is first observation. No RNG in OLS. Same 2x3x4 fixture; compare forward, inverse and truncated inverse matrices. Remove final row for incomplete max_order=2. No regularization.

comparison.justification: Float64 agreement across independent finite differences, unmodified pinned author functions and GraphFLA; not a paper figure reproduction.
